erp.description: Equity risk premium assumption in % (default 5.5 — Damodaran mature market estimate). Override for emerging markets or sector adjustments.

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, NVDA, MSFT). Case-insensitive.

Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.025 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Computes stock WACC (Weighted Average Cost of Capital) for any US company using CAPM cost of equity (live 10Y Treasury + beta × ERP), after-tax cost of debt (interest expense / total debt), and market-value capital structure weights. The discount rate needed to run a DCF model.

erp.description: Equity risk premium assumption in % (default 5.5 — Damodaran mature market estimate). Override for emerging markets or sector adjustments.

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, NVDA, MSFT). Case-insensitive.

name: wacc-calculator

cost_of_debt_pct.description: After-tax cost of debt in %: (interest_expense / total_debt) × (1 - effective_tax_rate).

cost_of_equity_pct.description: CAPM cost of equity in %: risk_free_rate + beta × ERP.

risk_free_rate_pct.description: 10Y Treasury yield used as risk-free rate (%).

notes.description: Fallback assumptions applied (e.g. beta defaulted to 1.0, tax rate defaulted to 21%).

wacc_pct.description: WACC as a percentage (e.g. 8.43 = 8.43%). Use as discount rate in DCF model.
